summary: Delegate attachment syntax while preserving naming and mail import
description: Explicit cooperation with Attachment Link Rules; preserve document names and bytes, native link style, and email behavior; safe absent-plugin fallback. Local integration only, no push/public release.
acceptance: Both plugins produce one stored attachment and one link with date kebab names, images-only embeds, native Wiki/Markdown style and unchanged email route; missing formatter falls back safely; actual isolated Obsidian acceptance and local validation pass.
